description: This file defines the CaseService class, which provides methods for managing test cases within a testing framework. It includes functionalities for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting test cases, interacting with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas.

classes.name: CaseService
classes.description: Service class providing test case management operations such as create, read, update, delete, and list.

methods.name: TestCase create_test_case(self, db: Session, case_data: TestCaseCreate, user_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new test case record in the database with provided data and user context.

methods.name: Optional[TestCase] get_test_case(self, db: Session, case_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a test case by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: List[TestCase] list_test_cases(self, db: Session, test_script_id: Optional[str] = None, name: Optional[str] = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Lists test cases with optional filters like test script ID and name, supporting pagination.

methods.name: TestCase update_test_case(self, db: Session, case_id: str, case_data: TestCaseUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing test case with new data.

methods.name: delete_test_case(self, db: Session, case_id: str)
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of a test case by setting its 'is_deleted' flag.

methods.name: int get_total_count(self, db: Session, test_script_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns the total count of test cases, with optional filtering by test script ID.
